report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.selector_line_range claim, associated review.rs implementation and full whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits test. This is source inspection; no behavior tests were run by this reviewer.

select resolves the fragment's file and uses split_inclusive on newline, preserving carriage returns and each actual terminating newline. It rejects start=0, end<start and end beyond the physical line count before slicing lines[start-1..end] and concatenating, which implements one-based inclusive bounds. A final unterminated line remains selectable without adding an ending; a trailing newline does not invent another selectable empty line. capture_read saves the unchanged LineRange selector and exact reversible source_lines. Freshness calls select again with those saved numbers rather than relocating text, so shifts across the fixed boundaries can conservatively change the selection and make it stale. This is intentional positional selection, not semantic tracking.

The associated test writes mixed-ending source with a CRLF blank line, LF third line and unterminated fourth line. It asserts lines 1–2 equal exactly first CRLF plus blank CRLF, and line 4 equals exactly last with no ending. Four negative ranges cover zero, reversed, an end beyond EOF and a start beyond EOF. After recording, editing unselected line 3 preserves validity while changing selected line 1 invalidates it, demonstrating that the saved range rather than the entire file is rechecked. The later WholeFile portion asserts repeated exact capture and terminal-newline freshness; it is additional representation evidence, not misreported as a range-shift execution. Fixed-number reuse under shifting is directly visible in the saved-selector/reselect implementation. Captured Fixture/TEST and shared check helpers show real saved reviews and gate calls, with assertions visible in the annotated body.

All claim requirements are accounted for: delimiter, one-based inclusive semantics, original endings, invalid bounds and positional freshness. No TODO/N/A entries or concrete defect were found. No source changes or additional edits are requested.
